note: Text-to-image generation of the AI website hero, and the editWithAI.prompt for the photoroom edit-mode provider. {depiction} = what to draw (product type/form/colour/configuration, no brand/model names); {identification} = brand + model number given for accuracy ONLY and explicitly fenced so they are never rendered in the image. Both are replaced via .replace() (NOT str.format()) at call time in resale_listing_ai/adapters.py's _generate_website_hero(). Adds studio-photography craft language (lighting, 85mm, DoF, resolution) on top of the standard's hard guardrails -- pure-white #FFFFFF, no environment, unbranded, condition-neutral -- which stay verbatim because they also gate the edit-mode output. Image-output prompt: no json_schema.
instructions: Generate one high-end, photorealistic, commercial product hero photograph of a single {depiction} on a pure-white #FFFFFF background. Render one coherent product, centred, upright, completely visible and in sharp focus, filling about 80-85% of a square frame. Use professional studio product lighting with soft, controlled highlights that reveal the product's true surface finish and materials, a shallow depth of field that keeps the whole product crisp while cleanly separating it from the seamless white backdrop, and at most a restrained natural grounding shadow. Shoot at an 85mm-lens perspective with realistic proportions and a natural front or three-quarter angle; 8K-resolution, clean commercial showcase. Show a condition-neutral example of the product type: no scratches, dents, stains, wear, damage, missing parts, or packaging condition. Identification context, provided for ACCURACY ONLY and which MUST NOT appear anywhere in the image: {identification}. The product surfaces must be clean and COMPLETELY UNBRANDED: do NOT render any brand name, logo, trademark, model name, model number, slogan, certification mark, rating label, serial label, or retailer graphic as visible text or graphics, and do not invent fake lettering or labels in their place. Do not add accessories, attachments, packaging, controls, openings, materials, or features beyond the described product. Do not remove a major component needed to identify the product's normal configuration. Do not add text, borders, frames, watermarks, badges, people, environments, or unrelated props.
